purpose: Teach: 断面/壁面/踊ら/西暦/果たさ/救命/抵触/徴兵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の断面、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、よく、絶対、見て、絶対、戦略、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look at the industry cross-section carefully. I'm counting on you to build strategy with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate delivery. Opens with quiet conviction. Each phrase lands with precision. Steady cadence, no rush. The weight of expectation held evenly across the breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社屋の壁面、本気で、絶対、改装、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're proceeding with the building renovation with complete dedication. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight bow in the voice—acknowledgment without embellishment. Clear, steady pacing. Professional but warm underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の流れ、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、踊らされないよう、絶対、心がけろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch the industry movements. Make sure the staff doesn't get swept along blindly. I'm relying on you to stay alert.
lines.style: Firmer now, with edge. Opens sharp. Rhythm quickens slightly—urgency beneath the composure. Each instruction lands like a tap on the table. Lean forward in intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業の西暦、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、知っていて、絶対、当たり前、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our founding year—every staff member knows it and should know it by heart. I appreciate the reminder of what matters.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. Breath deepens with thought. Acknowledges the weight of history. Quiet certainty. Not defensive, but grounded. Small pause before the closing gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の遺志、本気で、絶対、果たさずに、絶対、退くわけにはいかない、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The founder's legacy. We cannot retreat until we've honored it. This isn't negotiable.
lines.style: Gravitas shifts deeper. Slower, heavier cadence. Opens with weight. Each phrase hangs in the air. No breath for interruption. The voice of someone carrying something that matters across decades.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の救命、本気で、絶対、健康管理、絶対、最優先、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The wellbeing of our people is our highest priority. We're putting health and safety first, always.
lines.style: Steady, grounded affirmation. Warm undertone—genuine care breaking through the formality. Medium pace, secure. This is something he believes. Not reciting; confirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、法に、絶対、抵触、絶対、しないコンプラ体制、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our compliance standards must be absolute. There is no margin for cutting corners or legal risk. I mean that.
lines.style: Severe, controlled intensity. Opens clipped. Each phrase distinct—no flowing between them. Underlying steel. Slow enough to hear the weight of each word. This is the boundary line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、創業者、絶対、徴兵経験者、絶対、当社の財産、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our founder's experience—from the war years, his service—that's the foundation of everything we are. I won't forget that.
lines.style: Quiet reverence with depth. Soft opening. Slightly slowed, as if in a small moment alone with this knowledge. Warm respect. Closing with genuine gratitude, like a prayer.
